name: TOTP Sign-In Success
summary: Accepts a valid TOTP proof for an identified durable identity and establishes a normal authenticated application session.

guards.expression: the identified account has TOTP enabled and the submitted code is valid and has not already been accepted

sourceReferences.note: VerifyTotpAsync provides the existing proof validation and replay prevention primitive.
CompleteSignInToAppAsync is the existing session-completion primitive used after an identity credential is accepted.
The only current TOTP verify endpoint requires a confirmed current user and therefore cannot implement this anonymous sign-in transition as-is.
